name: Garden & outdoor
description: Garden furniture, outdoor items, sport kit and vehicles, modelled for Home 3D from simple shapes. Ships with the app and works offline.
release_note: Wheel arches on every car with a curved body: the tyres show and the cars no longer look sunk into the ground (run 6). New: a rattan garden set with black legs (tub chair, 2-seat bench, small glass-top table), a bike helmet and a wall-hung pizza peel. Curved bodies for 193 cars (#252); the Nissan Leaf reworked: slim headlamps, blue grille, dark tailgate glass, boomerang tail lamps (#345). Needs a Home 3D newer than 0.2.1.
